Government to sell up to 2% stake in IRFC

The Indian government announced plans to sell up to a 2% stake in the Indian Railway Finance Corporation (IRFC) through an offer for sale. The sale is scheduled to begin on Wednesday. This move is part of the government's strategy to divest stakes in public sector undertakings.
